{{Quote|Have you ever seen the botanical gardens at the Skydome? Amazing plants in there, a nice place where you can eat, all kinds of stuff.|Etain Tur-Mukan|<ref name="RC:TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>}}
The '''Skydome Botanical Gardens''' was a complex on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was the headquarters for the [[Order of the Canted Circle]]. It was also where the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] held a reception for [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Furgan]] of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]].

==History==
Constructed during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] by a wealthy [[Unidentified philanthropist|philanthropist]], founder of the [[Galactic News Service]], the gardens displayed exotic and endangered flora within a rooftop terrarium.<ref name="ISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> Jedi Knight [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] went to the gardens with [[Darman Skirata]].<ref name="RC:TC" />

On [[2 ABY/Legends|2:11:13 ABY]], [[Coruscant Daily Newsfeed/Legends|Coruscant Daily Newsfeed]] reported that [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] was invited to join the elite [[Order of the Canted Circle]] on Emperor Palpatine's behest and in recognition of his recent successes. The invitation surprised many due to Thrawn's alien origins and particularly Grand Admiral [[Rufaan Tigellinus]], who saw Thrawn's return as a threat to the powerful faction he had assembled within the Imperial Court. Nevertheless, he was inducted into the Order in a ceremony at the Skydome Botanical Gardens.<ref name="GNN12">{{JournalCite|12|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
